title: GamesIndexDocumentUpsertedPayload
description: games.index_document.upserted v1 (OpenVibe.Games apps/server/src/worlds/searchIndex.ts, via openvibe-publishing/search-feed). The OpenVibe.Search document of a published creator world (type world, /worlds/<id>, which opens the world in /play): its title, the player who made it and their summary. Sent when a world is published, renamed or edited while published, and by the sweep at boot and on a timer; a world that is unpublished, taken down by staff or deleted becomes a tombstone. The sequencer (games_index_revisions) gives an unchanged document its old revision and nothing is sent. Always visibility public and publication_state published. Facets: kind (creator_world), owner (the maker's display name). Consumed by OpenVibe.Search ('*.index_document.*'). Envelope: subject { type: world, id, revision: <document revision> }, visibility internal, actor service:games.
